title: Schema ledger
description: The database schema versions that reached a device. run-migration's check-migration reads it; record-shipped appends to it.

openPath.description: Repo path of the module that exports openAppDatabase (default src/data/app-database.ts).

shipped.description: One entry per shipped version, versions 1..N in order. Never edit or remove an entry.

stepSha256.description: sha256 of src/data/migrations/vNNNN-<name>.ts with CRLF read as LF.

fixtureSha256.description: sha256 of src/data/migrations/fixtures/db-vN.sql with CRLF read as LF.

firstShippedIn.description: The first build or update that carried this version, for example '1.4.0 (37)' or 'update 3f2c... on production'.

contentTest.description: Only for a version shipped before this ledger was adopted: why it has no vNNNN-<name>.test.ts.
